verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a search engine that stores user documents and embeddings. However, the evidence pack documents no export, dump, or bulk-download capability, and no open export format. Self-hosting as a single binary and the published OpenAPI spec relate to portability and API access, not to exporting all data and leaving, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
